list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before this guide was written. Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; the guides are this entry's own words. The game released on 19 November 2026, so every guide is derived from the official description and the counts PlayStation tracks, and says so where a detail cannot be verified yet.
sources: Official trophy descriptions, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI
PSNProfiles trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI (grades, hidden flags and progress counts)

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then side strands, collectibles, activities, combat and money, and finish with 100% completion. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally at the start of the game and cannot be missed — just play the story from the beginning. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. This is pure story progress: keep playing the main missions in order until the chapter closes. No side work is needed and it cannot be missed. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep following the main story missions after Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends. Story-only, and it cannot be missed. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story progress only: play the main missions through to the end of the chapter. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter. Finish its main missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes and the story moves toward its finale. Story-only, cannot be missed. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the gold story trophy: finish the last mission and the ending plays. Before you start it, clear the missable trophies flagged in this guide, since the story will be over afterwards. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Play it when the story offers it and finish it — mission-completion trophies unlock on finishing the mission, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by finishing the mission when the story reaches it. No extra objective is needed. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Finish the mission when the story offers it; the trophy is awarded for completion alone. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A named story mission: play it through to the end when it appears in the story and the trophy unlocks. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission when the story offers it; completion alone earns the trophy. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission: finish it when it appears and the trophy unlocks on completion. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The in-game checklist counts everything: story, side missions, activities and collectibles. Use this guide's tracker to clear every category first — this is the last trophy before the platinum, and it unlocks the moment the checklist hits 100%. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; completion scope per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; completion scope per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are driving feats — jumps, near misses and airtime — and the count is cumulative across the whole playthrough. Drive aggressively while travelling between missions and it builds up on its own; use the tracker to watch the total climb. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; count of 250 per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in Leonida — the trophy list itself names races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation spots and hunting among them. Sample one of each type the game offers and tick them off in the tracker as you go. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 9 activity types per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; activity count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every challenge at the range and replay any that fall short of gold until the gold score is met — challenges can be retried, so none of this is missable. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 42 challenges per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; challenge count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Win at least one race at each location; races can be retried, so a lost race costs nothing but the attempt. Visit the locations in the activities stage. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 14 locations per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; location count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty distinct race events count — not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list across Leonida, ticking each win off in the tracker, and it pairs naturally with the drone races. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; count of 20 per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish against Cal when the challenge appears and outscore him. This guide flags it missable because the challenge is a one-off contest against a named character — take it the first time it is offered rather than assuming it comes back. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade game to its end — arcade machines are found around Leonida, and finishing one game is enough. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Side-character strands unlock as the story opens them up — check the map for Andy's marker after each chapter. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Find stranger encounters as you explore the map and finish 8 full strands. They appear across the state, so check the map after each chapter and sweep new markers during the side-strands stage. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 8 strands per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; strand count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand through to its last mission and finish it. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Visit each meditation spot and meditate there; spots can be visited in any order at any time, so sweep them during the collectibles stage and tick each one off in the tracker. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 18 spots per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; spot count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for — start from Bret's request rather than hunting at random, since the trophy is tied to his specific animal. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect the cards scattered across Leonida and finish any 3 full sets. Cards are a collectible like the others — sweep them during the collectibles stage and use the tracker to see which sets are complete. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 3 sets per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; set count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations across Leonida. The count is cumulative, so do it whenever you pass a new spot and it fills in over the playthrough. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 100 locations per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; location count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Finish any 50 of the game's challenges — they span activities, driving and combat, so this fills in naturally while working the other trophies. Check the tracker to see how close you are before grinding the remainder deliberately. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 50 challenges per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; challenge count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape until the stars clear. This guide flags it missable because it needs your partner present — do it while the story keeps you together, not after. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, rob them one after another while keeping the wanted level alive between them, and move fast. This guide flags it missable because it needs your partner — do it during the story window when they are with you. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — a new vehicle counts on discovery, so grab every unfamiliar car, bike, boat and aircraft you see. It pairs with registering vehicles for On the Spot. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 100 vehicles per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; vehicle count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends — pick a busy fight with clustered enemies. It can be retried, so a failed attempt costs nothing. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 5 enemies per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; enemy count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. The description points to leaving the airport in a way no schedule allows — an unauthorised exit from VCIA. This guide flags it missable because the wording reads as a one-off departure moment: attempt it the first time you are at the airport with the means to leave. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the heat inside Rhino tanks, and it names no count or place — so this trophy is tied to encounters with Rhino tanks. Expect it to unlock from stealing, destroying or surviving a Rhino during combat or a high wanted level. Treat it as a combat trophy and engage Rhinos when they appear. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, get in and out without raising the alarm: plan the approach, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone spots you. It can be retried, so a failed run costs nothing but the attempt. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big heist-style robberies — plan the getaway before you go in, and escape cleanly to bank the progress. The count is cumulative across vaults. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 5 vaults per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; vault count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and escape before the police close in. Trucks appear in free roam, so this can be done any time after the story opens the map up. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive, fly and sail through every part of the state, then sweep the remaining blank areas in the collectibles stage. The tracker counts the areas as you clear them. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 52 areas per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; area count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Hit one operation per gang — nine in total — and tick each gang off in the tracker as you clear it. Operations are found in free roam across the state. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 9 gangs per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; gang count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, get a cocktail where the view is the point, and enjoy it. Any time in free roam works — it is a small moment, not a mission. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a vehicle showroom, get in a car and leave through the glass — the classic GTA smash-out. Any showroom works; drive out hard and the trophy pops. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a frame at that specific alley — it is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None. Head to the alley in free roam and bowl. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it points to a partnership moment that lands with the public. This guide flags it missable because it reads as a specific story beat: follow the partnership storyline and it should unlock from the moment it describes, so do not rush past partnership scenes. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The game tracks the choices you make, and PlayStation tracks a count toward 500. Make choices as the story offers them — this guide flags it missable because some choices are one-time story decisions that cannot be revisited, so do not rush past dialogue choices. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; count of 500 per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed on a second attempt at something — the trophy's own wording says the second try is the charm. This guide flags it missable because it may require failing once first: if you fail something once, retry it rather than reloading an old save, or a first-try success could skip it. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — the description reads like a rare or random event. This guide flags it missable because strange encounters may be one-off: explore off the beaten path, stop for anything unusual, and do not dismiss odd scenes. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon. Find a quiet road, line up a target and swing as you pass. It can be retried as often as needed. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies — launder them steadily through your contacts as you earn them, and the total climbs toward $250,000 across the playthrough. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; $250,000 per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; amount per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and more all count, and the total accumulates across the whole playthrough — buy what you need as you go and it fills in. Save the big purchases for the money stage if you are close. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; $100,000 per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; amount per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Save money for them during the money stage of the roadmap — each one is a property purchase, and the trophy pops when the eighth is bought. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 8 properties per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; property count per PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone to register any 10 vehicles you own or find. It pairs with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good. Source: official trophy description, PlayStation via the Exophase trophy list; 10 vehicles per the PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase trophy list; vehicle count per PSNProfiles trophy list
